dispositions.DQ-F2R1-1: AUTHOR DECISION: Ctrl at toolbar activation on Windows; modifier from the specific activation event, never a global flag; NORMAL / MEMORY_ENABLED latched; explicit toggle is a separately authorized fallback, not part of the design
dispositions.DQ-F2R1-2: AUTHOR DECISION: every qualifying toolbar activation, including reactivation, establishes the behaviour; latest wins; unchanged keeps the partial selection; a change cancels the gesture with initNewMode subject to FR-3; never a geometric construction
dispositions.DQ-F2R1-3: AUTHOR DECISION (refined): persists until departure or reactivation; departure resets to NORMAL; tool changes and Escape keep valid references; a language change by itself resets neither the behaviour nor the references (FR-1); F2 invalidation unchanged; no stale reuse after undo/redo
dispositions.DQ-F2R1-4: AUTHOR DECISION (refined): toolbar, reactivation and native flyout use the originating event; indirect activations without a validated modifier origin are NORMAL incl. same mode; internal resynchronization never changes the behaviour; genuine requests distinguished from host synchronization (FR-2 for scripting); Space NORMAL; Ctrl+Space not claimed; macOS/Linux NOT_ESTABLISHED
dispositions.DQ-F2R1-5: AUTHOR DECISION: localized status-bar indication while MEMORY_ENABLED ('Parallel Line · Memory' / 'Paralela · Memoria', 'Perpendicular Line · Memory' / 'Perpendicular · Memoria'); no icon or action; reflects the activation state; single-row layout compatible (FR-4)
dispositions.DQ-F2R1-6: AUTHOR DECISION: GeoCeDG-owned Desktop classes and resources; BOUNDED_PHASE conditioned on the entry gate; phase PRE-G9B-R6-PLUS-F2-R1 with compile.desktop.semantic, junit.desktop.pre-g9b-r6-plus-f2-r1.semantic, workspace-profile.product; no inherited, shared, mode-id, XML or command change
